contract: Revisioned annotation documents reference canonical artifact IDs and exact binary versions. Each contains stable note IDs/text, optional contained normalized image rectangles or bounded video time marks, and creator/license/HTTP source attribution. SQLite stores annotations and immutable revision history only; original media/import provenance remains canonical and unchanged. Atomic optimistic revisions and request-id replay protect edits. Deleted sources preserve readable notes with unavailable status. History summaries paginate and exact revision reads support restoration as new revisions.
acceptance: Save/edit/replay/conflict/read historical and restore notes through real SQLite, HTTP and native tools; use actual image/video bytes, verify source version isolation and unchanged bytes/provenance; reject malformed note shapes/regions/times/URLs and caller scope overrides; retain notes on deleted source; page history; render real annotation entry/list UI with honest unavailable/loading/duration states. Browser interactions remain integrated qualification.
remaining_limits: Video duration is explicitly unverified; timestamps are bounded but not compared with decoded duration
Actual browser annotation editing/restoration/preview journey pending root integration
Central tool metadata enrollment and durability registration owned by root
